Description: [ScenarioItems] Enable the unused Danger Room Scenario Vendor (native DesignState:NotInGame inherited from Vendor.defaults) so it can be spawned at Moira MacTaggert's old marker and sell the Blue/Purple/Cosmic scenario crates.
[ScenarioItems] Name the actual blue crate sold by the Danger Room Scenario Vendor as the Cosmic Rift launcher.
[ScenarioItems] Tooltip for the actual blue crate sold by the Danger Room Scenario Vendor.
[ScenarioItems] Give the actual Cosmic Rift vendor crate the Cosmic Rift icon.
[ScenarioItems] Name the actual purple crate sold by the Danger Room Scenario Vendor as the Rift Gauntlet launcher.
[ScenarioItems] Tooltip for the actual purple crate sold by the Danger Room Scenario Vendor.
[ScenarioItems] Give the actual Rift Gauntlet vendor crate the Rift Gauntlet icon.
[ScenarioItems] Give the actual Rift Gauntlet vendor crate the Rift Gauntlet high-resolution icon.
[ScenarioItems] Give the actual Rift Gauntlet vendor crate the Rift Gauntlet tooltip icon.
[ScenarioItems] Give the actual Rift Gauntlet vendor crate the Rift Gauntlet store/vendor icon.
[ScenarioItems] Name the actual cosmic crate sold by the Danger Room Scenario Vendor as the Boss Gauntlet launcher.
[ScenarioItems] Tooltip for the actual cosmic crate sold by the Danger Room Scenario Vendor.
[ScenarioItems] Give the actual Boss Gauntlet vendor crate the Boss Gauntlet icon.
[ScenarioItems] Give the actual Boss Gauntlet vendor crate the Boss Gauntlet high-resolution icon.
[ScenarioItems] Give the actual Boss Gauntlet vendor crate the Boss Gauntlet tooltip icon.
[ScenarioItems] Give the actual Boss Gauntlet vendor crate the Boss Gauntlet store/vendor icon.

[ScenarioItems] Replace the crate's native OnUse (ItemActionReplaceSelfLootTable -> OneBlueScenario, which drops a themed one-off portal item into inventory) with an ItemActionUsePower using the same shared summon power (Powers/FortuneCards/DangerRoom/PortalToDangerRoomScenario.prototype) that all 3 real technical beacons use - ItemPrototype.GetPortalTarget() requires a genuine SummonPowerPrototype with SummonEntityContexts to resolve a target region at all, so a non-portal placeholder power (originally tried: DangerRoomScenarioCrateDropUniqueCableFight, a SpawnLootTable power) silently fails to launch anything.
[ScenarioItems] Append the matching ItemActionDestroySelf (fires on OnUsePowerActivated by default) so the crate consumes itself once used, same as CableFight's own action list.
[ScenarioItems] Same OnUse rewrite as DangerRoomScenarioCrateBlue, for the Rift Gauntlet Scenario launcher.
[ScenarioItems] Append matching ItemActionDestroySelf, same as DangerRoomScenarioCrateBlue.
[ScenarioItems] Same OnUse rewrite as DangerRoomScenarioCrateBlue, for the Boss Gauntlet Scenario launcher.
[ScenarioItems] Append matching ItemActionDestroySelf, same as DangerRoomScenarioCrateBlue.
[ScenarioItems] Trim the vendor to exactly one scenario item per Rift mode: Cosmic Rift, Rift Gauntlet, and Boss Gauntlet.
